arguments.title: Historical note: May 8, 2023 runbook-ownership audit scope
arguments.body: Before the May 8 audit, I organized the service scope to keep the ownership pass concrete. My primary-owned list was `metrics-router`, `ingest-edge`, and `shard-keeper`; I also brought a separate list of services connected to those systems so the team could resolve boundary questions without spending the meeting debating edges. In the earlier prep inventory, I flagged `legacy-aggregator` as a migration-era service still in use and the old metric-rollup service as effectively unowned, so those historical cases would not disappear from the review. The audit’s goal was to give every service a named primary and backup. I wanted the discussion to stay mechanical: identify scope, then establish ownership.
